result.brief: 在统一基于模型的强化学习框架中整合24种内在动机目标，系统比较重构、潜空间预测与冗余消除三类表征学习策略所构建的世界模型在零样本、少样本与多任务控制上的表现。
result.reason: Studies how intrinsic-motivation objectives interact with world-model representation learning (reconstruction, latent prediction, redundancy reduction) and downstream control, directly addressing world-model representation design.
